acceptanceCriteria.text: the same small app (a window, a list, a text field, an image) exists for Zinc, Electron and Tauri in a bench directory, with the script that builds and measures them

size on disk of the shipped app, time from launch to first frame and resident memory after 10 s are measured on the development Mac, alone on the machine, five runs each, and logged in docs/reports/zinc-next-perf.md
where Zinc is not clearly ahead, the cause is named and given as lines for backlog/later.md

task.title: Numbers against Electron and Tauri: size, start time, memory of the same small app
